Bones - The Fury in the Jury
A key witness turns up dead in a case for which Brennan is a juror, so the team works to discover what has happened.

The team investigates the murder of a food scientist whose body was put through a meat grinder and mixed into canned stew; Angela puts together a post-wedding bachelorette party for Brennan.
Bones - The Spark in the Park
When a gymnast's remains are found in a park, Booth and Brennan discover she was living a double life; Cam confronts the woman who stole her identity.
Bones - The Ghost in the Killer
The team investigates when the remains of a girl who died 18 years earlier are delivered to Brennan and Booth's house; Brennan dreams about Pelant.

Bones - The Master in the Slop
Sweets goes undercover in the chess world to find a killer; Cam gets a science award but fears offending Brennan, who feels she deserves it; a sunny new podiatrist intern annoys Brennan.
Bones - The Heiress in the Hill
The team investigates the murder of a kidnap victim whose remains were found at a park; Hodgins makes a discovery about his family; Brennan and Booth consider commingling their money.
Bones - The Source in the Sludge

NCIS: New Orleans - Stashed

After a Molotov cocktail is hurled into Pride's bar, evidence leads him to his old nemesis, Sasha Broussard; Tammy uses her profiling skills on Hannah and Carter with shocking accuracy.
NCIS: New Orleans - Choices

The team investigates the deadly bar bombing and impending criminal turf war involving Sasha Broussard; Pride must come to terms with having Connor in his life; Carter and Hannah work to define their new relationship.
NCIS: New Orleans - Illusions

Pride directs the team to link Sasha to the recent attacks in New Orleans; Carter and Tammy search for a stolen highly trained military dog; Pride and Rita make an important decision about their wedding.
NCIS: New Orleans - Runs in the Family
Pride and Rita plan their wedding; the FBI arrests Connor in connection to the bar's firebombing.
NCIS: New Orleans - Laissez les Bon Temps Rouler

Hawaii Five-0 - Ku I Ka Pili Koko
